reliance-industries-limited.name: Reliance Industries Limited
reliance-industries-limited.description: Reliance Industries Limited is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai. Its businesses include energy, petrochemicals, natural gas, retail, entertainment, telecommunications, mass media, and textiles. It is the largest public company in India by market capitalization and revenue.

rosneft.name: Rosneft
rosneft.description: Rosneft Oil is a Russian public joint-stock integrated energy company based in Moscow. It specializes in exploration, extraction, production, refining, transport, and sale of petroleum, natural gas, and petroleum products. The company is state-owned through its parent company Rosneftegaz.

rosseti.name: Rosseti
rosseti.description: PAO Rosseti is a Russian power company comprising interregional and regional distribution grid companies, research and development institutes, and construction entities. It has 97 subsidiaries across 69 Russian regions and was formed from the reorganization of RAO UES.

renault.name: Renault
renault.description: Renault S.A., known as Groupe Renault, is a French multinational automobile manufacturer established in 1899. It produces cars and vans and has historically manufactured trucks, tractors, tanks, buses, aircraft, and autorail vehicles.

rushydro.name: RusHydro
rushydro.description: RusHydro is a Russian hydroelectricity company headquartered in Moscow. It was the world's second-largest hydroelectric power producer in 2009 and is Russia's largest power-generating company. The company underwent major consolidation starting in 2007 and is partly government-owned.

rusal.name: Rusal
rusal.description: United Company Rusal is a Russian aluminum company and was the world's largest primary aluminum producer until 2016. It accounts for nearly 9% of global primary aluminum and alumina production and was founded by industrialist Oleg Deripaska.

rexel.name: Rexel
rexel.description: Rexel S.A. is a French company specializing in the distribution of electrical, heating, lighting, and plumbing equipment. It also focuses on renewable energies and energy efficiency products and services. The company operates primarily in France.

ralph-lauren-corporation.name: Ralph Lauren Corporation
ralph-lauren-corporation.description: Ralph Lauren Corporation is an American fashion and lifestyle brand founded in 1967 in New York City. It markets apparel, home products, accessories, and fragrances under various brands including its flagship Polo Ralph Lauren. The company offers products ranging from mid-range to luxury labels.

renesas-electronics.name: Renesas Electronics
renesas-electronics.description: Renesas Electronics Corporation is a Japanese semiconductor manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo. It supplies embedded processors, analog, power and connectivity devices, and related software for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT applications. It ranked third worldwide in the microcontroller market in 2025.

rwe.name: RWE
rwe.description: RWE AG is a German multinational energy company headquartered in Essen. It generates and trades electricity across the Asia-Pacific region, Europe, and the United States.

rocket-companies.name: Rocket Companies
rocket-companies.description: Rocket Companies, Inc. is an American fintech and homeownership services company based in Downtown Detroit, Michigan. It is one of the largest mortgage lenders in the United States through its subsidiary Rocket Mortgage. Its subsidiaries include Redfin, Forsalebyowner.com, and Rocket Money.

rede-energia.name: Rede Energia
rede-energia.description: Rede Energia Participacoes, formerly Rede Energia, is a Brazil-based utility holding company focused on electricity energy. It is one of the largest electricity companies in Brazil.

rtl-group.name: RTL Group
rtl-group.description: RTL Group S.A. is a Luxembourgish-German international media conglomerate with a corporate office in Cologne, Germany. It operates 86 television channels and 42 radio stations across Europe, offers national streaming platforms, content production, and digital services. Key segments include RTL Deutschland, Groupe M6, and Fremantle.

rosbank.name: Rosbank
rosbank.description: Rosbank is a Russian bank currently operating as a branch of T-Bank with its own brand focused on corporate clients. In 2024, it ranked 11th among Russian banks by assets and was named the third most reliable Russian bank by Forbes Russia.

rockwool.name: Rockwool
rockwool.description: Rockwool A/S, also known as the ROCKWOOL Group, is a Danish multinational manufacturer of mineral wool products headquartered in Hedehusene, Denmark. Its research and development unit is co-located with its Copenhagen headquarters.

robert-half.name: Robert Half
robert-half.description: Robert Half Inc. is an international human resource consulting firm founded in 1948 and based in California. It is one of the world's largest accounting and finance staffing firms with over 345 locations worldwide.

rakuten-group-inc.name: Rakuten Group, Inc.
rakuten-group-inc.description: Rakuten Group, Inc. is a Japanese technology conglomerate headquartered in Tokyo. Founded in 1997 by Hiroshi Mikitani, it operates a global system of internet services centered around its online retail marketplace Rakuten Ichiba.

rostselmash.name: Rostselmash
rostselmash.description: Rostselmash is a Russian agricultural equipment company based in Rostov-on-Don. Founded in 1929, it primarily produces combine harvesters. The company name is an abbreviation of its original Russian name referring to the Rostov factory for agricultural machines.

rostvertol.name: Rostvertol
rostvertol.description: JSC Rostvertol is a Russian helicopter manufacturer located in Rostov-on-Don, founded in 1939. It has produced helicopters designed by the Mil design bureau since 1956 and is a world leader in manufacturing heavy-lift helicopters.

rsted.name: Ørsted
rsted.description: Ørsted A/S is a majority state-owned Danish multinational energy company headquartered in Fredericia, Denmark. It is the largest energy company in Denmark and adopted its current name in November 2017, previously known as DONG Energy.

ryman-healthcare.name: Ryman Healthcare
ryman-healthcare.description: Ryman Healthcare Limited is a New Zealand company operating retirement villages and rest homes. It is publicly listed on the New Zealand Stock Exchange and was among the largest companies on the NZX 50 Index.

royal-unibrew.name: Royal Unibrew
royal-unibrew.description: Royal Unibrew is a brewing and beverage company headquartered in Faxe, Denmark. It owns several brands including Ceres and Faxe, and has a presence in the Baltic region and Finland. The company also brews and markets Heineken and Pepsi in Denmark.

rubrik.name: Rubrik
rubrik.description: Rubrik, Inc. is an American cloud data management and data security company founded in 2014. It is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, and is publicly listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

robertet.name: Robertet
robertet.description: Robertet SA is a French manufacturer specializing in natural raw materials for fragrances and flavors. Founded in 1850, it is a member of the European Flavour Association. In 2021, it ranked 12th on FoodTalks' Global Top 50 Food Flavours and Fragrances Companies list.

rosenbauer.name: Rosenbauer
rosenbauer.description: The Rosenbauer Group is an Austrian manufacturer of fire-service vehicles and firefighting equipment. It is the third largest company worldwide in this sector and is based in Leonding, Austria.

ryobi.name: Ryobi
ryobi.description: Ryobi Limited is a Japanese manufacturer of components for the automobile, electronics, and telecommunications industries. It also sells printing equipment, power tools, and builders' hardware. The Ryobi brand for power tools and outdoor equipment is licensed to Techtronic Industries.

renren.name: Renren
renren.description: Renren Network, formerly Xiaonei Network, was a Chinese social networking service popular among college students. Renren Inc. was headquartered in Beijing with offices in Shanghai and Guangzhou, and had a $740 million IPO on the New York Stock Exchange in 2011.

raba-jarmuipari-holding-nyrt.name: Rába Járműipari Holding Nyrt.
raba-jarmuipari-holding-nyrt.description: Rába Automotive Group is a Hungarian public company headquartered in Győr. It engineers and manufactures automotive components, specialty vehicles, and axles for commercial vehicles and machinery. The company has been building axles and vehicles since 1902 and employs over 2000 people.

rostelecom.name: Rostelecom
rostelecom.description: Rostelecom is Russia's largest provider of digital services for consumers, businesses, and government entities. It interconnects local public operators' networks into a single national network for long-distance service. The company is publicly traded on the Moscow Exchange.

ringkjbing-landbobank.name: Ringkjøbing Landbobank
ringkjbing-landbobank.description: Ringkjøbing Landbobank is a bank headquartered in Ringkøbing, Denmark. Founded in 1886, it operates in the banking sector providing financial services. The bank has a long history dating back to the 19th century.

rossi-residencial.name: Rossi Residencial
rossi-residencial.description: Rossi Residencial is a Brazilian construction and real estate company. As of 2013, it was the sixth largest residential construction company in Brazil, competing with firms like PDG, Cyrela Brazil Realty, MRV, and Brookfield Incorporações.

redes-energeticas-nacionais.name: Redes Energéticas Nacionais
redes-energeticas-nacionais.description: REN - Redes Energéticas Nacionais, SGPS, S.A. is a Portuguese energy company managing the country's National Electricity Transmission Grid and National Natural Gas Transportation Grid. It handles planning, construction, operation, and maintenance of these infrastructures to ensure stable energy supply and equal grid access.

rocky-mountain-chocolate.name: Rocky Mountain Chocolate
rocky-mountain-chocolate.description: Rocky Mountain Chocolate is an international franchiser, confectionery manufacturer, and retail operator based in Durango, Colorado, United States. The company has outlets in Panama and the Philippines and was formerly known as Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory, Inc.

royal-caribbean-group.name: Royal Caribbean Group
royal-caribbean-group.description: Royal Caribbean Group is a cruise holding company headquartered in Miami, Florida, United States, and incorporated in Liberia. It fully owns three cruise lines and holds a 50% stake in TUI Cruises. The group operates a global fleet of 71 ships.

rumble.name: Rumble
rumble.description: Rumble, Inc. is an American AI, infrastructure, and video company headquartered in Longboat Key, Florida. It was founded in 2013 by Canadian tech entrepreneur Chris Pavlovski. The company operates in the AI and software industry.

reliance-worldwide-corporation.name: Reliance Worldwide Corporation
reliance-worldwide-corporation.description: Reliance Worldwide Corporation is an Australian-owned publicly listed company that designs, manufactures, and supplies water flow and control products. It is the world's largest manufacturer of PTC behind-the-wall plumbing fittings and operates in multiple countries including Australia, the US, and the UK.

resolute-mining.name: Resolute Mining
resolute-mining.description: Resolute Mining Limited is an Australian mining corporation focused on gold mining operations in Africa. It operates two gold mines: the Syama Gold Mine in Mali and the Mako Gold Mine in Senegal.

riverbed-technology.name: Riverbed Technology
riverbed-technology.description: Riverbed Technology LLC is an American information technology company offering software and hardware products focused on Unified Observability, Network Visibility, End User Experience Management, network and application performance monitoring, and wide area networks including SD-WAN and WAN optimization.

robinsons-retail.name: Robinsons Retail
robinsons-retail.description: Robinsons Retail Holdings, Inc. is one of the largest multi-format retailers in the Philippines.

randgold-resources.name: Randgold Resources
randgold-resources.description: Randgold Resources was a gold mining business headquartered in Jersey, Channel Islands, operating mainly in Mali. It was listed on the London and NASDAQ stock exchanges until it merged with Barrick Gold in December 2018.

rockchip.name: Rockchip
rockchip.description: Rockchip is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company based in Fuzhou, Fujian province, with offices in several major cities. It designs system on a chip products using ARM architecture licensed from ARM Holdings.

reckitt.name: Reckitt
reckitt.description: Reckitt is a British multinational consumer goods company headquartered in Slough, UK. It manufactures health and hygiene products.

rohm.name: Rohm
rohm.description: Rohm Co., Ltd is a Japanese electronic parts manufacturer based in Kyoto. It was founded in 1958 as Toyo Electronics Industry Corporation by Kenichiro Sato.

rambus.name: Rambus
rambus.description: Rambus Inc. is an American technology company that designs and licenses chip interface technologies used in digital electronics. Founded in 1990, it is known for inventing RDRAM and its intellectual property litigation related to DDR-SDRAM.

revvity-inc.name: Revvity Inc.
revvity-inc.description: Revvity, Inc. is a multinational life sciences and diagnostics company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It focuses on pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries, especially in cell and gene therapy developments, and originates from PerkinElmer.

resona-holdings.name: Resona Holdings
resona-holdings.description: Resona Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese holding company for Resona Group, the fifth-largest banking group in Japan as of 2012. It is headquartered in Tokyo and includes Resona Bank and Saitama Resona Bank as its main operating entities.

realnetworks.name: RealNetworks
realnetworks.description: RealNetworks LLC is an American technology company based in Seattle, Washington. It provides Internet streaming media delivery software and services, along with subscription-based online entertainment and mobile messaging services.

remy-cointreau.name: Rémy Cointreau
remy-cointreau.description: Rémy Cointreau is a French family-owned business group specializing in the production and distribution of alcoholic beverages including cognac, triple sec, and whisky. The group was formed in 1990 after the merger of Rémy Martin and Cointreau and also owns the fragrance company Maison Psyché.

rediff.name: Rediff
rediff.description: Rediff.com is an Indian website offering news, information, entertainment, email services, and shopping. Founded in 1996 by Ajit Balakrishnan, it was the first Indian website to become a mainstream news media organization. The company is headquartered in Mumbai with offices in Bengaluru, New Delhi, and New York City.

revlon.name: Revlon
revlon.description: Revlon, Inc. is an American multinational company headquartered in New York City, founded in 1932. It produces cosmetics, skin care, perfume, and personal care products sold in 150 countries. The company has global locations including Mexico City, London, Paris, and Tokyo.

retailmenot.name: RetailMeNot
retailmenot.description: RetailMeNot, Inc. is an American multinational company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It operates a collection of coupon websites including RetailMeNot.com and VoucherCodes.co.uk and acquires coupon sites and third-party software.

rockwell-automation.name: Rockwell Automation
rockwell-automation.description: Rockwell Automation, Inc. is an American provider of industrial automation and digital transformation technologies headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Its brands include Allen-Bradley and FactoryTalk software, serving customers in over 100 countries.

rogers-communications.name: Rogers Communications
rogers-communications.description: Rogers Communications Inc. is a Canadian communications and media company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It operates in wireless communications, cable television, telephony, and Internet services, with additional assets in telecommunications, mass media, and professional sports.

roper-technologies.name: Roper Technologies
roper-technologies.description: Roper Technologies, Inc. is a holding company based in the United States that owns companies in the technology sector. It operates as a conglomerate with a focus on technology businesses.

rocket-fuel-inc.name: Rocket Fuel Inc.
rocket-fuel-inc.description: Rocket Fuel was an ad technology company based in Redwood City, California. Founded in 2008 by Yahoo! alumni, it specialized in advertising technology.

rogers-corporation.name: Rogers Corporation
rogers-corporation.description: Rogers Corporation is a specialty engineered materials company based in Chandler, Arizona. It focuses on producing engineered materials for various applications.

ramsay-health-care.name: Ramsay Health Care
ramsay-health-care.description: Ramsay Health Care Limited is an Australian multinational healthcare provider and hospital network founded in Sydney in 1964. It operates in Australia, Europe, the UK, and Asia, specializing in surgery, rehabilitation, and psychiatric care.

richard-pieris-company-plc.name: Richard Pieris & Company PLC
richard-pieris-company-plc.description: Richard Pieris and Company (ARPICO) is a Sri Lankan conglomerate established in 1940 with interests in manufacturing, engineering, retail, and plantations. It is a pioneer in Sri Lanka's tyre, plantation, and rubber industries and employs over 25,000 people with major brands including Arpitec, Arpidag, and Arpico.

repligen.name: Repligen
repligen.description: Repligen Corporation is a life sciences company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts. It develops and manufactures products used in biological drug manufacturing and is listed on Nasdaq under the symbol RGEN.

rockwell-medical-inc.name: Rockwell Medical Inc.
rockwell-medical-inc.description: Rockwell Medical Inc. is a pharmaceutical company based in Wixom, Michigan. Founded in 1996, it focuses on developing and commercializing treatments for diseases such as end-stage renal disease and chronic kidney disease.

ricoh.name: Ricoh
ricoh.description: Ricoh Company, Ltd. is a Japanese multinational imaging and electronics company founded in 1936. Its headquarters is located in Ōta, Tokyo, and it originated from the commercial division of the Institute of Physical and Chemical Research (Riken).

reinsurance-group-of-america.name: Reinsurance Group of America
reinsurance-group-of-america.description: Reinsurance Group of America, Incorporated is a holding company for a global life and health reinsurance entity based in Chesterfield, Missouri, United States. It focuses primarily on life and health-related reinsurance and has grown to be an international company in this sector.

robinhood.name: Robinhood
robinhood.description: Robinhood Markets, Inc. is an American financial services company based in Menlo Park, California. It provides an electronic trading platform for various financial instruments and offers additional services including cryptocurrency wallets, wealth management, and banking products.

rayonier-advanced-materials.name: Rayonier Advanced Materials
rayonier-advanced-materials.description: Rayonier Advanced Materials (RYAM) is an American company specializing in cellulose-based technologies and high-purity cellulose specialties. Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, it serves industries including filters, food, pharmaceuticals, paper, and packaging.

restaurant-brands-international.name: Restaurant Brands International
restaurant-brands-international.description: Restaurant Brands International Inc. is a Canadian multinational fast food holding company based in Toronto. Formed in 2014 by the merger of Burger King and Tim Hortons, it also owns Popeyes and Firehouse Subs.

renonorden.name: RenoNorden
renonorden.description: RenoNorden is a Norwegian multinational waste collection company headquartered in Frogner, Norway.

ramayana-lestari-sentosa.name: Ramayana Lestari Sentosa
ramayana-lestari-sentosa.description: PT Ramayana Lestari Sentosa Tbk is an Indonesian retail company operating department stores and supermarkets across Indonesia. As of 2021, it runs 86 Ramayana department stores, 82 Robinson supermarkets, and 2 Cahaya department stores. The company primarily targets middle to lower income customers.

rimo-international-lestari.name: Rimo International Lestari
rimo-international-lestari.description: Rimo International Lestari is a company headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. It was founded in 1987. The summary does not provide further details about its operations.

rr-donnelley.name: RR Donnelley
rr-donnelley.description: R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co. is an American integrated communications company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. It provides marketing and business communications, commercial printing, and related services. In 2007, it was the world's largest commercial printer.

recruit-holdings.name: Recruit Holdings
recruit-holdings.description: Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd. is an HR Tech holding company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It operates in the tertiary sector of the economy. The company focuses on human resource technology services.

reliance-power.name: Reliance Power
reliance-power.description: Reliance Power Limited is an Indian company established to develop, construct, operate, and maintain power projects domestically and internationally. It is part of the Reliance Group and promoted by Reliance Infrastructure and Reliance ADA Group. The CEO since May 2018 is K. Raja Gopal.

riskified.name: Riskified
riskified.description: Riskified is a publicly traded Israeli company providing software for ecommerce risk management. Its services include fraud prevention and chargeback management for online retailers.

realpage.name: RealPage
realpage.description: RealPage, Inc. is an American company headquartered in Texas that produces property management software for algorithmic rent setting. It is owned by private equity firm Thoma Bravo and its services are used on over 24 million housing units worldwide.

russneft.name: Russneft
russneft.description: Russneft is a Russian oil company headquartered in Moscow, established in 2002 by Mikhail Gutseriev. It is a member of the SAFMAR industrial and financial group.

renasant-bank.name: Renasant Bank
renasant-bank.description: Renasant Bank is an American regional commercial financial institution based in Tupelo, Mississippi. It operates more than 280 branches across several southern states and is affiliated with Renasant Corporation and the Renasant Nation platform.

radware.name: Radware
radware.description: Radware Ltd. is an American provider of cybersecurity and application delivery products for physical, cloud, and software-defined data centers. Its global headquarters is in Israel, and its shares are traded on NASDAQ.

recipe-unlimited.name: Recipe Unlimited
recipe-unlimited.description: Recipe Unlimited Corporation is a Canadian company operating several restaurant chains including Swiss Chalet and Harvey's. It also provides food distribution services for large operations.

reald.name: RealD
reald.description: RealD 3D is a digital stereoscopic 3D projection technology made and sold by RealD. It is the most widely used technology for watching 3D films in theaters in the United States.

ripley-s-a.name: Ripley S.A.
ripley-s-a.description: Ripley S.A. is a Chilean company headquartered in Santiago that operates department stores, financial services, and shopping mall management. It has operations in Peru and formerly operated in Colombia.

rite-aid.name: Rite Aid
rite-aid.description: Rite Aid Corporation was an American drugstore chain based in Philadelphia. Founded in 1962 in Scranton, Pennsylvania, it operated more than 5,000 stores at its peak. By May 2025, it operated 1,200 stores across 15 U.S. states and was the seventh-largest pharmacy in the U.S. including big box chains.

riyad-bank.name: Riyad Bank
riyad-bank.description: Riyad Bank is one of the largest financial institutions in Saudi Arabia. It is ranked fourth in assets among banks in the country.

ross-dress-for-less.name: Ross Dress for Less
ross-dress-for-less.description: Ross Stores, Inc., operating as Ross Dress for Less, is an American discount department store chain headquartered in Dublin, California. It is the second largest off-price retailer in the U.S. and operates 1,795 stores in 43 states plus Washington, D.C., Puerto Rico, and Guam.

rubis.name: Rubis
rubis.description: Rubis SCA is a France-based international company specializing in storage, distribution, and sale of petroleum, LPG, food, and chemical products. It is market leader in several countries including France, Switzerland, and Jamaica. The company operates through subsidiaries such as Coparef and Rubis Terminal.

razer-inc.name: Razer Inc.
razer-inc.description: Razer Inc. is a Singaporean-American multinational technology company that manufactures and markets gaming-focused computer hardware, consumer electronics, and financial services. It operates in the video game industry.

range-resources.name: Range Resources
range-resources.description: Range Resources Corporation is a natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas. It operates in the Marcellus Formation, where it is the largest landowner.

rhb-bank.name: RHB Bank
rhb-bank.description: RHB Bank Berhad is a Malaysian bank based in Kuala Lumpur, founded in 1997. It is the fourth largest fully integrated financial services group in Malaysia. The name RHB represents the initials of its founder, Rashid Hussain Berhad.

rusagro.name: Rusagro
rusagro.description: Rusagro is one of Russia's largest agricultural companies and a major producer of pork, fats, and sugar. Established in 1995 as a sugar producer, the company is led by CEO Maxim Basov.

rockwell-collins.name: Rockwell Collins
rockwell-collins.description: Rockwell Collins, Inc. was a multinational corporation headquartered in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, providing avionics and IT systems and services to government agencies and aircraft manufacturers. It was formed in 1973 when Rockwell International purchased Collins Radio Company and was spun off as Rockwell Collins in 2001.

r1-rcm.name: R1 RCM
r1-rcm.description: R1 RCM Inc. is an American revenue cycle management company servicing hospitals, health systems, and physician groups across the United States. It was acquired in a deal completed in November 2024 by TowerBrook Capital Partners and Clayton, Dubilier & Rice.

rpm-international.name: RPM International
rpm-international.description: RPM International Inc. is an American multinational company that manufactures and markets specialty coatings, sealants, and building materials. Its industrial brands include Tremco and Carboline, while consumer brands include Rust-Oleum and DAP. The products serve professionals, DIY users, and hobbyists.

roivant.name: Roivant
roivant.description: Roivant Sciences Ltd. is an American multinational healthcare company focused on applying technology to drug development. Founded in 2014, it is headquartered in New York City with major offices in Boston and Basel. The company builds subsidiary life sciences and health technology companies.

ribbon-communications.name: Ribbon Communications
ribbon-communications.description: Ribbon Communications Inc. is a public company headquartered in Plano, Texas. It produces software, IP, and optical networking solutions for service providers, enterprises, and critical infrastructure sectors. The company was formed in 2017 from the merger of Genband and Sonus Networks.

rami-levi-chain-stores-hashikma-marketin.name: Rami Levi Chain Stores Hashikma Marketing 2006 Ltd
rami-levi-chain-stores-hashikma-marketin.legal_name: Rami Levi Chain Stores Hashikma Marketing 2006 Ltd
rami-levi-chain-stores-hashikma-marketin.description: Rami Levy Hashikma Marketing is the third largest Israeli retail supermarket chain, founded in 1976 in the Mahane Yehuda Market district. It operates 44 discount supermarkets in Central and Northern Israel and the West Bank, and distributes wholesale to 450 stores. The company has diversified into clothing, real estate, and cellular communications.

listings.name: Rami Levi Chain Stores Hashikma Marketing 2006 Ltd

renewable-energy-group.name: Renewable Energy Group
renewable-energy-group.description: Renewable Energy Group is a biodiesel production company headquartered in Ames, Iowa. It operates 12 biorefineries and a feedstock processing facility. As of 2018, it was recognized as a Fortune 1000 corporation.

rs-public-company-limited.name: RS Public Company Limited
rs-public-company-limited.description: RS Group is a Thai entertainment and media company founded in 1982. It operates two main business groups: Commerce, including RS Mall and Lifestar Company Limited, and Media and Entertainment, which includes Channel 8, COOLism, and RS Music. The company is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

ryohin-keikaku.name: Ryohin Keikaku
ryohin-keikaku.description: Ryohin Keikaku Co., Ltd., known as Muji, is a Japanese retailer selling a wide variety of household and consumer goods. It is based in Japan and operates in the retail industry. The company is recognized for its diverse product offerings.

rebl-group.name: Rebl Group
rebl-group.description: Rebl Group Plc is a Finnish media group headquartered in Joensuu. Its shares are listed on the Helsinki Stock Exchange. In January 2024, the Keskisuomalainen Group announced plans to buy PunaMusta Media’s newspapers and radio station, after which Rebl Group will focus on graphic and digital marketing communication services.

r-f-properties.name: R&F Properties
r-f-properties.description: R&F Properties is a Chinese property developer based in Zhujiang New Town, Guangzhou, Guangdong. Established in 1994, it is one of the largest real estate companies in Guangzhou. The company integrates real estate design, development, engineering supervision, sales, property management, and real estate intermediary services.

rada-electronic-industries-ltd.name: Rada Electronic Industries Ltd
rada-electronic-industries-ltd.description: RADA Electronic Industries Ltd. is an Israeli global defense technology company specializing in proprietary radar and legacy avionics systems. Founded in 1970, it develops, manufactures, and sells products primarily for the defense and aerospace markets. It has U.S.-based subsidiaries and has been traded on the NASDAQ Capital Market since 1985.

rli-corp.name: RLI Corp.
rli-corp.description: RLI Corp. is an American insurance company headquartered in Peoria, Illinois. It specializes in property and casualty insurance. The company operates within the insurance industry in the United States.

rmg-networks.name: RMG Networks
rmg-networks.description: Korbyt, formerly known as RMG Networks, is an American workplace software and digital signage company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. It provides a platform for content management, performance dashboards, and data visualization for desktops and mobile devices. The company traces its origins to Symon Communications from the early 1980s.

rpx-corporation.name: RPX Corporation
rpx-corporation.description: RPX Corporation is an American company based in San Francisco that provides international risk management services for patents. Founded in 2008, it acquires patents that pose potential problems and provides litigation information to reduce patent assertions against its clients.

radcom-ltd.name: Radcom Ltd
radcom-ltd.description: RADCOM Ltd. is an Israeli provider of quality monitoring and service assurance software for telecommunications carriers. Founded in 1991, it has its U.S. headquarters in Paramus, New Jersey, and international headquarters in Tel Aviv, Israel. RADCOM is part of the RAD Group and is traded on the Nasdaq exchange.

radisys.name: RadiSys
radisys.description: Radisys Corporation is an American technology company based in Beaverton, Oregon. Founded in 1987 by former Intel employees, it produces technology used by telecommunications companies in mobile networks. The company went public in 1995.

radian-group.name: Radian Group
radian-group.description: Radian Group Inc. is a mortgage insurance company based in the United States. It offers a suite of mortgage, risk, real estate, and title services. The company operates within the insurance sector.

raimon-land.name: Raimon Land
raimon-land.description: Raimon Land is a Thai real estate development company specializing in condominium buildings in Bangkok, Pattaya, and Phuket. It has developed more than 20 residential properties in Thailand. The company focuses on residential real estate development within the country.

rpt-realty.name: RPT Realty
rpt-realty.description: RPT Realty is a real estate investment trust in the United States that owns and operates open-air shopping centers. It owns numerous shopping centers and retail properties through wholly owned and joint ventures. The company was formerly known as RAMCO Properties Trust and was acquired by Kimco Realty in 2024.

ramco-systems.name: Ramco Systems
ramco-systems.description: Ramco Systems Limited is an Indian multinational enterprise software product and platform provider. Founded in 1997, it is part of the Ramco Group and headquartered in Chennai, India. The company operates in the enterprise software sector.

ranhill-holdings-berhad.name: Ranhill Holdings Berhad
ranhill-holdings-berhad.description: Ranhill Utilities Berhad is a Malaysian conglomerate with interests in the environment and power sectors. It provides water supply services, operates water and wastewater treatment plants, and develops power generation assets. Its operations are primarily in Malaysia and other Asian markets.

rathbone-brothers.name: Rathbone Brothers
rathbone-brothers.description: Rathbones Group Plc is a UK provider of personalized investment management and wealth management services for private investors and trustees. Services include discretionary investment management, unit trusts, tax planning, and pension advice. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

ratos.name: Ratos
ratos.description: Ratos AB is a Swedish listed investment company founded in 1934, headquartered in Stockholm. It owns majority and minority holdings in Nordic companies and is listed on the Stockholm Stock Exchange. The company operates as a long-term investment company.

raven-industries.name: Raven Industries
raven-industries.description: Raven Industries, Inc. is an American company based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, that makes precision agriculture products and information management tools for growers. It previously produced plastic films and manufactured high-altitude balloons and military equipment before being acquired by CNH Industrial in 2021.

raymond-james-financial.name: Raymond James Financial
raymond-james-financial.description: Raymond James Financial, Inc. is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida. It provides financial services to individuals, corporations, and municipalities through subsidiaries engaged in investment, financial planning, investment banking, and asset management.

recipharm.name: Recipharm
recipharm.description: Recipharm is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CDMO) based in Sweden. It employs 5,200 people and operates in over a hundred markets worldwide, providing pharmaceutical development and manufacturing services.

redbubble.name: Redbubble
redbubble.description: Redbubble is an online marketplace founded in 2006 in Melbourne, Australia, that offers print-on-demand products featuring user-submitted artwork. The company also maintains offices in San Francisco and Berlin, serving a global customer base.

red-lion-hotels-corporation.name: Red Lion Hotels Corporation
red-lion-hotels-corporation.description: Red Lion Hotels Corporation, known as RLH Corporation, is an American hospitality company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It franchises, manages, and owns upscale, mid-scale, and economy hotels with 90,000 rooms across more than 1,400 properties in North America.

red-robin.name: Red Robin
red-robin.description: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers, Inc. is an American casual dining restaurant chain founded in 1940 in Seattle, Washington. Headquartered in Greenwood Village, Colorado, it operates hundreds of restaurants specializing in classic American fare including burgers and fries.

refah-bank.name: Refah Bank
refah-bank.description: Refah Bank, also known as Refah Kargaran Bank, is a major retail commercial bank based in Tehran, Iran. It is owned and controlled by the Social Security Organization of Iran and offers a range of financial products and services.

regal-rexnord.name: Regal Rexnord
regal-rexnord.description: Regal Rexnord Corporation is a manufacturer of electric motors and power transmission components headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The company operates manufacturing, sales, and service facilities across the United States, Canada, Mexico, Europe, and Asia.

regal-hotels-international.name: Regal Hotels International
regal-hotels-international.description: Regal Hotels International is one of the largest hotel groups in Hong Kong. The company is incorporated in Bermuda and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

regency-centers.name: Regency Centers
regency-centers.description: Regency Centers Corporation is a real estate investment trust based in Jacksonville, Florida. It operates shopping centers anchored by grocery stores and owns notable properties including Serramonte Center and a 30% interest in Village District.

regeneron-pharmaceuticals.name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals
regeneron-pharmaceuticals.description: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American biotechnology company headquartered in Westchester County, New York. Founded in 1988, it initially focused on neurotrophic factors and has expanded into cytokine and tyrosine kinase receptor research, producing a VEGF-trap product.

regis-corporation.name: Regis Corporation
regis-corporation.description: Regis Corporation is an American operator of hair salons headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. As of August 2021, it operated over 5,800 salons including franchised and company-owned locations.

reliance-inc.name: Reliance, Inc.
reliance-inc.description: Reliance, Inc. is the largest metals service center operator in North America, headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona. It provides metals processing services and distributes a wide range of metal products to fabricators and manufacturers.

religare.name: Religare
religare.description: Religare Enterprises Limited is an Indian investment and financial services holding company headquartered in New Delhi. It is listed on the National Stock Exchange of India and Bombay Stock Exchange and registered with the Reserve Bank of India.

renishaw-plc.name: Renishaw plc
renishaw-plc.description: Renishaw plc is a British engineering company based in Wotton-under-Edge, England. It produces coordinate-measuring machines and machine tool products and is listed on the London Stock Exchange as part of the FTSE 250 Index.

rent-the-runway.name: Rent The Runway
rent-the-runway.description: Rent the Runway is an American e-commerce platform based in New York City that allows users to rent, subscribe, or buy designer apparel and accessories. It was founded in November 2009 by Jennifer Hyman and Jennifer Fleiss.

rentrak.name: Rentrak
rentrak.description: Rentrak Corporation is a global media measurement and research company serving the entertainment industry. It is headquartered in Portland, Oregon, with additional offices in the United States and worldwide.

republic-bank-trust-company.name: Republic Bank & Trust Company
republic-bank-trust-company.description: Republic Bank & Trust Company is a bank based in Louisville, Kentucky, United States.

republic-services.name: Republic Services
republic-services.description: Republic Services, Inc. is an American waste disposal company providing non-hazardous solid waste collection, transfer, disposal, recycling, and energy services. It is the second largest waste disposal provider in the US and is partly owned by Bill Gates's Cascade Investment.

resmed.name: ResMed
resmed.description: Resmed Inc. is a medical equipment company based in San Diego, California, founded in Australia. It provides cloud-connectable devices for sleep apnea and respiratory conditions and produced ventilators to treat COVID-19 respiratory symptoms.

restoration-hardware.name: Restoration Hardware
restoration-hardware.description: RH is an American home furnishings company headquartered in Corte Madera, California. It sells merchandise through retail stores, catalogs, and online, operating galleries and outlet stores across the US and Canada.

rit-technologies.name: RiT Technologies
rit-technologies.description: RiT Technologies Ltd. is a publicly traded Israeli company providing network management systems. Its shares are traded on the NASDAQ Capital Market.

ricegrowers-limited.name: Ricegrowers Limited
ricegrowers-limited.description: Ricegrowers Limited, known as SunRice, is one of the largest rice food companies globally and a leading branded food exporter based in Australia.

rigaku.name: Rigaku
rigaku.description: Rigaku Corporation is an international manufacturer and distributor specializing in scientific, analytical, and industrial instrumentation focused on X-ray technologies.

ringcentral.name: RingCentral
ringcentral.description: RingCentral, Inc. is an American company providing AI-powered cloud-based communication and collaboration products and services.

ringer-hut.name: Ringer Hut
ringer-hut.description: Ringer Hut is a Japanese fast-food restaurant chain specializing in Nagasaki dishes like Champon and Sara udon, operating over 550 restaurants in Japan and Taiwan with headquarters in Fukuoka and Tokyo.

rockhopper-exploration.name: Rockhopper Exploration
rockhopper-exploration.description: Rockhopper Exploration PLC is a UK-based oil and gas exploration company headquartered in Salisbury, owning offshore exploration and production licenses in the North Falkland Basin.

rockland-trust.name: Rockland Trust
rockland-trust.description: Rockland Trust is a commercial bank based in Rockland, Massachusetts, serving Southeastern and Coastal Massachusetts, Cape Cod, and Boston's MetroWest. It was established in 1907 as Rockland Trust Company.

rocky-brands.name: Rocky Brands
rocky-brands.description: Rocky Brands, Inc. is a United States company that designs, develops, manufactures, and markets outdoor, work, western, and military footwear along with apparel and accessories. Founded in 1932 in Nelsonville, Ohio, it maintains its corporate headquarters there.

rohto-pharmaceutical-co-ltd.name: Rohto Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
rohto-pharmaceutical-co-ltd.description: Rohto Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational corporation headquartered in Ikuno-ku, Osaka. It specializes in fast-moving consumer goods and pharmaceuticals, focusing primarily on skin and eye care products, cosmetics, supplements, and over-the-counter medications.

rollins-inc.name: Rollins Inc.
rollins-inc.description: Rollins, Inc. is a North American pest control company serving residential and commercial clients globally through subsidiaries. It provides pest control services and protection against termites, rodents, and insects to millions of customers across multiple continents.

rosetta-genomics.name: Rosetta Genomics
rosetta-genomics.description: Rosetta Genomics Ltd. was a molecular diagnostics company with offices in Israel and the United States. It used microRNA biomarkers to develop diagnostic tests to differentiate various cancer types, submitting its first tests for regulatory approval in 2008.

rosetta-stone.name: Rosetta Stone
rosetta-stone.description: Rosetta Stone Language Learning is proprietary computer-assisted language learning software published by Rosetta Stone Inc. in the United States. The software teaches words and grammar using images, text, and sound through a method called Dynamic Immersion.

royal-gold.name: Royal Gold
royal-gold.description: Royal Gold, Inc. is a precious metals stream and royalty company headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Founded in 1981 as Royal Resources Corporation, it changed its name to Royal Gold in 1986.

radius-recycling-inc.name: Radius Recycling, Inc.
radius-recycling-inc.description: Radius Recycling, Inc. is a scrap recycling and steel manufacturing company headquartered in Portland, Oregon. It operates metals recycling facilities and owns Cascade Steel Rolling Mills. The company was acquired by Toyota Tsusho in July 2025.

rex-airlines.name: Rex Airlines
rex-airlines.description: Rex Airlines Pty Ltd is an Australian regional airline based in Mascot, New South Wales. It operates scheduled regional turboprop services and briefly operated jet services between major Australian cities. The airline entered voluntary administration in 2024 and exited after acquisition in 2025.

rinnai.name: Rinnai
rinnai.description: Rinnai Corporation is a Japanese multinational company based in Nagoya, Japan. It manufactures gas appliances including energy-efficient tankless water heaters, home heating and kitchen appliances, as well as commercial-use equipment like rice cookers and grillers.

raspadskaya.name: Raspadskaya
raspadskaya.description: OJSC Raspadskaya is a coal-mining company based in Russia and headquartered in Mezhdurechensk, Kemerovo Oblast. It is majority-owned by Evraz and produces 7 million tons of coal annually.

regions-financial-corporation.name: Regions Financial Corporation
regions-financial-corporation.description: Regions Financial Corporation is an American bank holding company headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama. It provides retail and commercial banking, trust, stock brokerage, and mortgage services through its subsidiary Regions Bank.

relaxo.name: Relaxo
relaxo.description: Relaxo Footwears Limited is an Indian multinational footwear company based in New Delhi. It is the largest footwear manufacturer in India by volume and second-largest by revenue, producing products under 10 brands including Flite and Sparx.

raiffeisen-bank-international.name: Raiffeisen Bank International
raiffeisen-bank-international.description: Raiffeisen Bank International is a key entity of the decentralized Raiffeisen Banking Group in Austria. It acts as the group's domestic central financial entity and holding company for operations outside Austria. The bank's major shareholders are eight regional Raiffeisen banks.

reliance-infrastructure.name: Reliance Infrastructure
reliance-infrastructure.description: Reliance Infrastructure Limited is an Indian private sector enterprise involved in power generation, infrastructure, construction, and defence. Headquartered in Navi Mumbai, it is part of the Reliance Group and led by chairman Anil Ambani. The company has interests in power plants, metro rail, airports, bridges, toll roads, and defence.

raspadskaya-coal-mine.name: Raspadskaya coal mine
raspadskaya-coal-mine.description: The Raspadskaya Coal Mine is the largest coal and underground mine in Russia, located in Mezhdurechensk, Kemerovo Oblast. Opened in 1973 and completed in 1977, the mining complex includes several underground and open-pit mines as well as a preparation plant.

renault-argentina.name: Renault Argentina
renault-argentina.description: Renault Argentina is the Argentine subsidiary of the French car manufacturer Renault. Established officially in 1975, it is one of the oldest Renault operations worldwide and consistently ranks first in sales among local automakers in Argentina.

rio-santiago-shipyard.name: Río Santiago Shipyard
rio-santiago-shipyard.description: The Río Santiago Shipyard is a major shipyard located in Ensenada, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina. Founded in 1953 and owned by the provincial government, it has served naval, industrial, and railroad sectors.

red-electrica-de-espana.name: Red Eléctrica de España
red-electrica-de-espana.description: Red Eléctrica de España is a partly state-owned Spanish corporation that operates the national electricity grid and power transmission system in Spain. It also holds assets in Peru, Chile, and Brazil.

rbc-information-systems.name: RBC Information Systems
rbc-information-systems.description: The RBC Group, or RosBusinessConsulting, is a Russian media group headquartered in Moscow. It was established in 1993 and operates in the communication sector.

rede-s-a.name: Rede S.A.
rede-s-a.description: Rede S.A., also known as Redecard, is a Brazilian multi-brand acquirer with 25 brands for credit, debit, and benefit cards. It offers merchant acquiring, transaction processing, POS terminal rental, and loyalty programs. It is the largest company in its sector in Brazil.

rovi.name: Rovi
rovi.description: Laboratorios Farmaceuticos Rovi SA is a pharmaceutical company based in Spain. It operates within the pharmaceutical industry.

rawbank.name: Rawbank
rawbank.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
rawbank.description: Rawbank is a regulated financial institution based in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Founded on 2 May 2002, it has grown to become the DRC's largest universal bank. The bank offers a range of financial services within the country.

rainmaker-entertainment.name: Rainmaker Entertainment
rainmaker-entertainment.description: Mainframe Studios is a Canadian animation studio based in Vancouver, British Columbia, and owned by Wow Unlimited Media. Founded in 1993 as Mainframe Entertainment Inc., it contributed to the introduction of computer-generated imagery (CGI) in animation, film, and television.

rwandan-red-cross.name: Rwandan Red Cross
rwandan-red-cross.description: The Rwandan Red Cross (RRC) is a humanitarian organization established in July 1962 in Kigali, Rwanda. It provides emergency and relief services within the country. The organization is part of the global Red Cross movement.

robam-appliances.name: Robam Appliances
robam-appliances.description: Hangzhou Robam Appliances Co., Ltd., known as Robam Appliances, is a Chinese manufacturer of kitchen appliances. The company is headquartered in Hangzhou, Zhejiang province.

riocan-real-estate-investment-trust.name: RioCan Real Estate Investment Trust
riocan-real-estate-investment-trust.description: RioCan Real Estate Investment Trust is the second-largest REIT in Canada, owning 164 properties across the country. It manages a net leasable area of 31.4 million square feet and is led by CEO Jonathan Gitlin. The company operates in the real estate sector.

rexam.name: Rexam
rexam.description: Rexam plc was a British multinational consumer packaging company headquartered in London. Originally a paper producer known as Bowater, it became a leading beverage can manufacturer with 55 plants worldwide before being acquired by Ball Corporation in 2016.

renewable-energy-corporation.name: Renewable Energy Corporation
renewable-energy-corporation.description: Renewable Energy Corporation (REC) is a solar power company headquartered in Singapore. It produces silicon materials for photovoltaic applications, multicrystalline wafers, solar cells, and modules. REC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Reliance New Solar Energy Limited.

romande-energie-holding.name: Romande Energie Holding
romande-energie-holding.description: Romande Énergie is a Swiss company involved in energy production, distribution, and marketing, as well as energy services. Its head office is located in Morges, in the canton of Vaud.

razgulay.name: Razgulay
razgulay.description: OJSC Razgulay Group was one of Russia's largest agribusiness companies based in Moscow. It operated in the agricultural sector before ceasing to be active.

rs-group-plc.name: RS Group plc
rs-group-plc.description: RS Group plc is a distributor of industrial and electrical products based in London, England. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index. The company operates in the industrials and chemicals sector.

ritek.name: Ritek
ritek.description: RITEK Corporation is a Taiwanese company that manufactures optical discs such as CDs, DVDs, and Blu-ray, as well as storage cards and flash drives. It also produces solar modules, touch panel products, and has launched products in nano- and biotechnology.

rps-group.name: RPS Group
rps-group.description: RPS Group Limited is a global professional services firm of consultants and service providers headquartered in Abingdon-on-Thames, England. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Tetra Tech in January 2023. The company operates in environmental consulting and related services.

raisio-group.name: Raisio Group
raisio-group.description: Raisio Group, known as Raisio Oyj, is a Finnish food production company. It operates internationally under the Raisio Group name. The company is based in Finland and works in the food industry.

real-goods.name: Real Goods
real-goods.description: Real Goods Solar Inc., doing business as RGS Energy, was a residential solar power integrator based in the United States. Founded in 1978, it sold some of the first retail solar panels in the country and served customers across all 50 states and 10 Canadian provinces. The company filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy in January 2020.

reata-pharmaceuticals.name: Reata Pharmaceuticals
reata-pharmaceuticals.description: Reata Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company based in Plano, Texas, founded in 2002. It focuses on developing experimental oral antioxidative and anti-inflammatory drugs that activate Nrf2 and inhibit NF-κB transcription factors. The last CEO was J. Warren Huff.

redrow-plc.name: Redrow plc
redrow-plc.description: Redrow plc was a major British housebuilder based in Flintshire, Wales, with 12 operational divisions across the UK and 2,300 employees. In October 2024, it merged with Barratt Developments to form Barratt Redrow.

repros-therapeutics.name: Repros Therapeutics
repros-therapeutics.description: Repros Therapeutics Inc. was a US-based development stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in The Woodlands, Texas. Founded in 1987 as Zonagen, it focused on developing oral small molecule drugs for male and female health but abandoned a vaccine-based contraceptive project after failed trials.

rocksource.name: Rocksource
rocksource.description: Rocksource was a Norwegian technology-based exploration and production petroleum company listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. It developed algorithms for processing Controlled Source Electromagnetic data for exploration and applied North Sea reservoir management techniques to onshore gas fields in east Texas.

roundy-s-supermarkets-inc-milwaukee.name: Roundy's Supermarkets, Inc. (Milwaukee)
roundy-s-supermarkets-inc-milwaukee.description: Roundy's Supermarkets, Inc. is an American supermarket operator owning stores under Pick 'n Save, Metro Market, and Mariano's Fresh Market. It operates supermarkets and pharmacies in Wisconsin and Illinois and is a subsidiary of Kroger since 2015.

rouse-properties.name: Rouse Properties
rouse-properties.description: Rouse Properties was a real estate investment trust headquartered in New York City. The company owned 35 shopping malls across 22 states, totaling approximately 24.5 million square feet of retail space.

russel-metals.name: Russel Metals
russel-metals.description: Russel Metals Inc. is a Canadian metals distribution and processing company. It operates across Canada and the United States and is one of North America's largest metal distribution companies.

regionair.name: RegionAir
regionair.description: RegionAir is an airline headquartered in Port-Gentil, Gabon. It focuses on regional flights in Central and West Africa and operates strictly as a charter airline for oil and gas companies. It does not sell tickets to the general public.

radiodiffusion-television-ivoirienne.name: Radiodiffusion télévision ivoirienne
radiodiffusion-television-ivoirienne.description: Radiodiffusion-Télévision ivoirienne (RTI) is the publicly owned radio and television authority of Côte d'Ivoire. It is financed through television and radio licenses, advertisements, and taxes.

recordtv-cabo-verde.name: RecordTV Cabo Verde
recordtv-cabo-verde.description: RecordTV Cabo Verde is a television channel in Cape Verde, launched on 31 March 2007. It is the first Brazilian-based channel to have its own version in Cape Verde. The channel is part of the Record network.

red-cross-of-cape-verde.name: Red Cross of Cape Verde
red-cross-of-cape-verde.description: The Red Cross of Cape Verde, abbreviated CVCV, was founded in 1984. It is headquartered on Avenida Andrade Corvo in Praia, Cape Verde. The organization provides emergency and relief services.

renault-tanger-mediterranee.name: Renault Tanger Méditerranée
renault-tanger-mediterranee.description: Renault Tanger Méditerranée is an industrial site of the Renault Group located in Malloussa near Tangier, Morocco.

royal-air-maroc.name: Royal Air Maroc
royal-air-maroc.description: Royal Air Maroc is the Moroccan national carrier and the country's largest airline. It is also among the largest airlines in Africa.

royal-air-maroc-express.name: Royal Air Maroc Express
royal-air-maroc-express.description: Royal Air Maroc Express is a regional airline and wholly owned subsidiary of Royal Air Maroc based in Casablanca. It operates scheduled domestic and regional flights, including to Spain and the Canary Islands, and is based at Mohammed V International Airport.

red-cross-society-of-niger.name: Red Cross Society of Niger
red-cross-society-of-niger.description: The Red Cross Society of Niger was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Niamey. It is part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, providing emergency and relief services in Niger.

radio-lagos.name: Radio Lagos
radio-lagos.description: Radio Lagos 107.5 FM is a state-owned FM radio station in Lagos State, Nigeria. It began operations in 1977 as an offshoot of the Nigerian Broadcasting Corporation. It is notable for being the first state-owned FM radio station in Lagos State.

ruparelia-group.name: Ruparelia Group
ruparelia-group.description: The Ruparelia Group is a privately owned conglomerate in Uganda. It is commonly referred to as the Ruparelia Group and has Sudhir Ruparelia as a shareholder in each of its companies.

refugee-law-project.name: Refugee Law Project
refugee-law-project.description: The Refugee Law Project is a human rights NGO established in 1999 as an outreach project of Makerere University's School of Law. It focuses on addressing refugee rights in Uganda.

royal-daisy-airlines.name: Royal Daisy Airlines
royal-daisy-airlines.description: Royal Daisy Airlines was a private airline in Uganda that is no longer in business. It operated in the aviation sector within Uganda before ceasing operations.

rwandatel.name: Rwandatel
rwandatel.description: Rwandatel was a telephony company headquartered in Kigali, Rwanda. It operated in the telecommunications sector providing telephony services in Rwanda.

rwandair.name: RwandAir
rwandair.description: RwandAir Limited is the national flag carrier airline of Rwanda, headquartered in Kigali. It operates flights to 25 destinations across Africa, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia from its primary hub at Kigali International Airport.

radio-garowe.name: Radio Garowe
radio-garowe.description: Radio Garowe is a radio station based in Garowe, Puntland, Somalia. Established in 2004, it broadcasts daily on 89.8 FM and launched an additional FM station in Bosaso in 2013.

republic-bank-ghana-limited.name: Republic Bank Ghana Limited
republic-bank-ghana-limited.description: Republic Bank (Ghana) PLC is a commercial bank licensed by the Bank of Ghana. It operates as a financial institution providing banking services within Ghana. The bank is regulated by the national banking authority.

rbs-tv.name: RBS TV
rbs-tv.description: RBS TV is a Southern Brazilian television network owned by Grupo RBS. It is one of the oldest affiliates of Rede Globo and originally stood for Rede Brasil Sul de Televisão, though it no longer uses the full name on-air. The network operates in Brazil's television industry.

renault-do-brasil.name: Renault do Brasil
renault-do-brasil.description: Renault Geely do Brasil, formerly Renault do Brasil, is the Brazilian subsidiary of French car manufacturer Renault and Chinese manufacturer Geely. Established in 1997, it is Brazil's fifth largest automaker by sales. In 2012, Brazil was the second largest market for Renault.

rei-do-mate.name: Rei do Mate
rei-do-mate.description: Rei do Mate is a Brazilian fast food chain specializing in tea house stores. It operates within the fast food restaurant industry in Brazil.

remgro.name: Remgro
remgro.description: Remgro Limited is a South African investment holding company based in Stellenbosch. It operates as a holding company within South Africa.

radio-bio-bio.name: Radio Bío-Bío
radio-bio-bio.description: Radio Bío-Bío is a Chilean radio station with broad coverage across the country. It broadcasts news, sports, music, economics, and international relations content.

ripio.name: Ripio
ripio.description: Ripio is an Argentine financial technology company focused on cryptocurrencies. Founded in Buenos Aires in 2013 as BitPagos, it started as a bitcoin payments processor and expanded into a cryptocurrency exchange, consumer wallet products, and institutional services.

red-cross-of-chad.name: Red Cross of Chad
red-cross-of-chad.description: The Red Cross of Chad was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in N’Djamena, Chad. It operates as a humanitarian organization providing emergency and relief services.

rutaca-airlines.name: RUTACA Airlines
rutaca-airlines.description: RUTACA Airlines is an airline headquartered in Ciudad Bolívar, Venezuela. Its home base is Tomás de Heres Airport, with a hub at Simón Bolívar International Airport in Caracas. It operates as a Venezuelan airline serving these locations.

record-report.name: Record Report
record-report.description: Record Report is the official singles chart for Venezuela, established in 1990. It ranks songs based on airplay within the country, serving as a music industry chart.

regional-brewery.name: Regional Brewery
regional-brewery.description: Cervecería Regional C.A. is a Venezuelan brewery founded in 1929 with headquarters in Maracaibo, Zulia. It produces beer and malt-based beverages and is considered the oldest and most traditional brewery in Venezuela.

roraima-airways.name: Roraima Airways
roraima-airways.description: Roraima Airways is a regional airline based in Guyana with its main hub at Eugene F. Correia International Airport. Founded in 1992, the airline is named after Mount Roraima. It provides regional air services within Guyana.

republic-bank.name: Republic Bank
republic-bank.hq: Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago
republic-bank.description: Republic Bank Limited is a Caribbean financial institution headquartered in Trinidad and Tobago with operations across multiple Caribbean countries and Ghana. It was formerly a division of Barclays Bank in Trinidad and Tobago.

rosario-mining-company.name: Rosario Mining Company
rosario-mining-company.description: The New York and Honduras Rosario Mining Company was an American-owned corporation operating the Rosario mine, which produced gold and silver in central Honduras and Nicaragua. It was involved in mining activities in Honduras.

regional-air-services.name: Regional Air Services
regional-air-services.description: Regional Air Services is an airline based in Arusha, Tanzania. It is the Tanzanian division of Airkenya and operates domestic and charter flights across East and Southern Africa.

royal-zambian-airlines.name: Royal Zambian Airlines
royal-zambian-airlines.description: Royal Zambian Airlines is a regional airline based at Kenneth Kaunda International Airport in Zambia. It operates as a subsidiary of Royal Air Charters, a Lusaka-based charter company. The airline connects Zambia with neighboring countries to facilitate business and tourist travel.

regional-cargo.name: Regional Cargo
regional-cargo.description: Regionalcargo Holdings, operating as Regional Cargo, was a Mexican cargo airline. Its headquarters were located on the grounds of Querétaro International Airport and in Colón, Querétaro. The airline specialized in cargo transport.

republicair.name: Republicair
republicair.description: RepublicAir was a Mexican airline founded in 2004 and based at Toluca International Airport. It was banned from operations in April 2007 but resumed service in July 2007 with a single Boeing 737-200 aircraft. The airline operated passenger flights.

red-cross-of-benin.name: Red Cross of Benin
red-cross-of-benin.description: The Red Cross Society of Benin, also known as RCB, was founded in 1959. It is headquartered in Porto-Novo, Benin. The organization provides emergency and relief services.

royal-air.name: Royal Air
royal-air.description: Royal Air was a charter airline based in Cotonou, Benin, with its main base at Cadjehoun Airport. The airline ceased operations as of July 2012.

regie-nationale-des-postes.name: Régie Nationale des Postes
regie-nationale-des-postes.description: Régie Nationale des Postes is the company responsible for providing postal services in Burundi. It operates as the national postal service provider in the country.

red-cross-of-the-democratic-republic-of-.name: Red Cross of the Democratic Republic of Congo
red-cross-of-the-democratic-republic-of-.legal_name: Red Cross of the Democratic Republic of Congo
red-cross-of-the-democratic-republic-of-.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
red-cross-of-the-democratic-republic-of-.description: The Red Cross of the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the national Red Cross organization founded by the International Committee of the Red Cross. It joined the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies in 1963 and is distinct from an earlier society that disbanded in 1909.
